description.narrative: This project sets out an ambitious agenda to build a high quality, demand-driven financing framework for Cambodia enabling the expansion of development resources in order to accelerate achievement of the CSDGs.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

Output 1 1. Finance Strategy Development 2. SDG Investor Map
Output 2: 1. Harmonization of M&E mechanisms between CSDGs and NSDP introduced, building on the findings from mid-term review of NSDP 2019-2023, CSDG budget tagging 2. Review of SDG tracking of ODA inflows published 3. Methodology and training on CSDG budget tagging put in place

1) INFF Finance Strategy: this is now on its 2nd irritation based on the consultations with the Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC), UNCT, various individual agencies and UN ESCAP. The finance strategy being finalized follows the INFF building frame, and fully aligned with the SDG Gap analysis. The INFF financing strategy is expected to go through its final irritation with the RGC and UNCT in October 2022.
2) SDG budget tagging methodology is developed with the technical support from UNDP Mexico Country Office. Piloting is expected to commence in July and complete by November 2022. The tool will enable government to track and report budget allocation and expenditure by SDG goals.
3) Cambodia SDG Investor Map will be the first market intelligence to guide SDG aligned investments in Cambodia, is being finalized and expected to be launched in August. The results of the exercise are being consulted with stakeholders from government, civil society, private sector, UN agencies, and development partners. Global SDG Impact Standards was also launched in Cambodia in April. The standards aim to provide guidance for businesses to integrate sustainability at the core of their businesses and align their internal processes, practices and decision-making towards the accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
JP’s priority activities consist of the followings: -The launch of SDG Investor Map which will engage key stakeholders from private, public and CSO -The completion of SDG budget tagging with the MEF and line ministries that enable them to keep track of their budget allocated to CSDGs which eventually help efficient resource allocation and national priorities-oriented policy adjustment. -The initiative of SDG FDI tagging with the Council for the Development of Cambodia, aiming to introduce tagging methodology for tagging of the FDI inflow to Cambodia. -The harmonization of SDG monitoring and evaluation with the objective to review and recommend pathways to establish a harmonized M&E mechanism for CSDGs building on the existing and possible tools. -The final irritation of INFF Finance Strategy: the strategy being finalized follows the INFF building frame, and fully aligned with the SDG Gap analysis. The INFF financing strategy is expected to go through its final irritation with the RGC and UNCT in October 2022. -The finalization of sub-national Government Revenues Study: this diagnostic study will examine fiscal space and non-tax revenues at local government levels. The research is being undertaken in partnership with the General Department of Local Government, Ministry of Economy, and Finance. -Capacity building for key government partners on INFF and SDG financing is planned in September with the support from SDG Finance Academy. -Consultant to draft the final narrative report is expected to start in October 2022. -Final joint programme steering committee meeting is planned in December 2022.
UNDP in collaboration with Sustainable Finance Hub organized virtual launch of SDG Impact Standards: -Link to Remarks by Ms. Alissar Chaker: Virtual Webinar on SDG Impact Standards | United Nations Development Programme (undp.org) -Link to LinkedIn post of the launch: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/undp-cambodia_sdgimpactstandards-cambodia-sdgs-activity-6922803082393247744-UnhP?utm_source=linkedin_share&utm_medium=member_desktop_web -Link to LinkedIn post (pre-event): https://www.linkedin.com/posts/undp-cambodia_sdgimpactstandards-sdgs-activity-6920690791250108416-extB?utm_source=linkedin_share&utm_medium=member_desktop_web
